# Ryan Stenning

AI systems engineer in Cape Town.

I put AI into real operating systems: integrations, monitored workflows, and cloud — not chatbot demos.

## Now

- Software Developer, Technical Operations at 365 Finance (UK SME lender, Cape Town branch). AI-assisted underwriting and ops pipelines on AWS Bedrock, orchestration in n8n, Salesforce as the system of record.
- Independent practice through Lumenyl: AI integrations and automation for mid-market teams. Systems of record over chatbot theatre.

## How I work

- Systems of record first. Integrate before you prompt.
- Readiness before model worship.
- A workflow is finished when it is monitored, owned, and boring.

## Stack

TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL. AWS, GCP, Docker. n8n, Salesforce, REST/API, ETL. AWS Bedrock and production agent workflows. Next.js / React / Node / PostgreSQL when a product surface is needed. Prior production: Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, Angular, Power Platform.
